messages:
Nora (Billing): Noticed a set of March invoices where totals don't reconcile after tax rounding + reserved credits. A few were rejected by Stripe.
Sam (Eng): Any job ids or log snippets?
Nora (Billing): job invoice-run-2026-03-25-01. Example lines:
```
usage: 123.45
reserved_credit: -50.00
vat: 0.00
VAT: 14.69
gross_total: 88.14
```
Nora (Billing): Rounding and inconsistent tax_code casing caused two VAT lines and final total off by -0.01 to -14.69 in some cases.
billing-bot: invoice-run-2026-03-25-01 reported 15 warnings, 2 errors: TAX_ROUND_MISMATCH, STRIPE_REJECT.
Diego (Payments): Stripe rejects negatives/invalid sums. We should pause the export for that run to avoid drafts.
Sam (Eng): Quick mitigation: exporter will reject invoices where abs(gross_total - (sum(lines)+sum(taxes))) > 0.05 and route to manual review. Also normalize tax_code case-insensitively and dedupe.
Leah (RevOps): We need CSV of affected invoices and owners for AM outreach. Also prepare standard credit-memo playbook if any customers got overcharged.
Nora (Billing): I'll compile the CSV. Preliminary affected: 10 EU customers, 1 enterprise.
Diego (Payments): Agree pause export. After fix, re-run only impacted invoices with idempotency keys. We'll also monitor webhook churn.
Sam (Eng): Adding unit test for rounding tolerance and tax dedupe. Quick guard deploy in ~90 mins, full fix tomorrow morning.
Nora (Billing): Holding exports now. I'll post customer notification draft in ~2 hours. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
